Reading the comparison

Source matters

A TRIXX-built home carries its build record and a commissioned device schedule. An owner listing is identity-checked but built by someone else, and we say so.

Smart tier is the running cost

Two homes at the same price can differ by tens of thousands a month in power and water. Compare the tier column before the price column.

Verified means checked

We confirm title, ownership and the physical property before the badge appears. A listing without it has not completed that process yet.

Need a second opinion

Book viewings back to back.
